title: Determine exact four-qubit width-ten Clifford Gram nullity
body:
**Enabling algebraic result: the full Gaussian-dyadic four-qubit Clifford Gram matrix at tensor width ten has exact nullity 193,919,902,208 and exact rank 11,934,748,974,592.** This resolves the remaining width-ten question from [PR #7770](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7770). **No new kappa** follows; T(4)=13 is unchanged.

Read the [proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/8561dad6b1dfd09d08b25564d70f4edb1270b5ee/research/clifford-width-ten-nullity/PROOF.md), [exact result](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/8561dad6b1dfd09d08b25564d70f4edb1270b5ee/research/clifford-width-ten-nullity/RESULT.json), [complete stabilizer projections and restrictions](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/8561dad6b1dfd09d08b25564d70f4edb1270b5ee/research/clifford-width-ten-nullity/STABILIZERS.json), [checker](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/8561dad6b1dfd09d08b25564d70f4edb1270b5ee/research/clifford-width-ten-nullity/verify.py), [archive extractor](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/8561dad6b1dfd09d08b25564d70f4edb1270b5ee/research/clifford-width-ten-nullity/extract.py), [source pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/8561dad6b1dfd09d08b25564d70f4edb1270b5ee/research/clifford-width-ten-nullity/SOURCE-PINS.json), [external inputs](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/8561dad6b1dfd09d08b25564d70f4edb1270b5ee/research/clifford-width-ten-nullity/EXTERNAL.json) and [credits](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/8561dad6b1dfd09d08b25564d70f4edb1270b5ee/research/clifford-width-ten-nullity/CREDITS.md).

At width ten, `V^10 = (V tensor V) tensor W9`. Actual Bell-line characters give the two quadratic-form sectors, with stabilizers of indices 120 and 136. Their 60 and 67 ordinary irreducibles account for the entire required central-character ideal. Seven minus-type modules and eight plus-type modules are absent; every other module occurs.

| Sector | Missing modules | Exact nullity |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Minus quadratic type | 7 | 102,154,809,600 |
| Plus quadratic type | 8 | 91,765,092,608 |
| Complete width-ten Gram | 15 | 193,919,902,208 |

The proof supplies all fifteen degrees. It uses the actual Bell-line extension and does not assume that the projective Clifford extension splits. All 127 multiplicities agree by two exact methods: fixed-space character sums and restriction of the source W9 decomposition. Independent quadratic-space orbit counts give the two character norms, 78,491,573,017 and 84,713,186,558.

Python 3.12 and the standard library:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/clifford-width-ten-nullity
```

Both registered modes print:

```text
PASS_CLIFFORD_WIDTH_TEN_NULLITY
Exact nullity 193919902208; exact rank 11934748974592; T(4)=13 unchanged
Minus: seven missing modules, nullity 102154809600; plus: eight, nullity 91765092608
All 127 multiplicities agree with quotient restrictions; complete regular dimension passes
Independent quadratic tuple norms 78491573017 and 84713186558; four complete small groups
```

The authenticated CTblLib 1.3.11 archive reconstructs all retained data. The extractor checks 14,650 ordinary row inner products, all 10,287 restriction coefficients, tensor rows, the exact seventeenth-root Galois action and both class fusions. All restriction coefficients are nonnegative integers. Direct Burnside counts for four complete small orthogonal groups check the separate orbit formula for tuple lengths zero through eight. Changed fusion, projected-character and omitted-Galois controls fail for the stated reasons.

Twenty-three retained source files are authenticated. The unchanged source, normal/optimized registered replay, optional archive command in the [README](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/8561dad6b1dfd09d08b25564d70f4edb1270b5ee/research/clifford-width-ten-nullity/README.md), syntax/indentation, committed bytes/source history/modes, export and sealed read-only Git-free serial replay pass. Hosted CI did not certify this package. The [plan job](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/44445922476/job/135297909052) failed in the shared `test_current_ci_section_matches_selected_record`: the base guide names frontier6030 while the selected record requires `make frontier7000-verify`. The log reports 760 tests, one failure and 24 skipped; package replay was skipped. This package changes no shared CI file. Local replay remains the scientific evidence.

Nick Petalas (@petalas) supplied [PR #7747](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7747)'s [W9 projection](https://github.com/petalas/integer-mult-bounds/blob/ff12ca358d601a21cd4b1f016b8a3a969ac44016/research/clifford-four-qubit-width-nine/PROJECTION.json) and [archive parser](https://github.com/petalas/integer-mult-bounds/blob/ff12ca358d601a21cd4b1f016b8a3a969ac44016/research/clifford-four-qubit-width-nine/verify.py). Ali Romman (@aliromman) supplied [PR #7766](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7766)'s [Bell-line extension and Dickson obstruction](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/d7c2dd1868c70f0addce2c0a4d3220149452f14b/research/clifford-four-qubit-threshold/PROOF.md) and [literal checker](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/d7c2dd1868c70f0addce2c0a4d3220149452f14b/research/clifford-four-qubit-threshold/verify.py), then [PR #7770](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7770)'s [symplectic class columns](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/ff9bdc0e82e75ab5ed39f3ff034ac8ddb3ea06d2/research/clifford-width-twelve-nullity/CHARACTER-COLUMNS.json). alephnan (@alephnan) supplied the [Pauli/quadratic-sector framework](https://github.com/alephnan/integer-mult-bounds/blob/f7f32a18dde54e67624a9ed9cc7e1b266d9585c0/research/clifford-three-qubit-threshold/PROOF.md) in [PR #6714](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6714). All earlier notices remain intact.

The ordinary tables and fusions credit the ATLAS and [Thomas Breuer's CTblLib](https://www.math.rwth-aachen.de/~Thomas.Breuer/ctbllib/ctbllib-1.3.11.tar.gz). The independent orbit proof uses [D. E. Taylor's Witt extension theorem, Theorem 7.4](https://www.maths.usyd.edu.au/u/don/papers/gcg.pdf#page=65). These are classical inputs, not new general theory.

The published tables and fusions are authenticated mathematical inputs; they were not rebuilt from group multiplication. Conditioning, larger qubit counts, native realization and complete caller pricing remain open. No full group or Gram matrix was materialized. The full three-qubit and width-twelve suites, selected cold replay, Lean and Docker were not run. All five framework assumptions and the selected frontier remain unchanged. No independent human/formal-kernel acceptance or global literature priority is claimed.
